# Ron Systems AI

> Ron Systems AI is the IT systems, automation and AI consultancy of Rolando "Ron" Tactay, an IT engineer with 11+ years across finance, healthcare, manufacturing, IT service providers (MSPs) and startups. It helps small and medium businesses automate manual work, adopt practical AI, and set up reliable systems. Vendor-neutral; clients own everything built. Contact: {{ contact_email }}

Tools named on this site are examples, not a complete list. Most business apps can be connected through their API, webhooks or exports.
